evidence.detail: Pattern 1 of remove_pd requires the trailing number to match season_id OR one of the letter suffixes; for '[PD2] Big Blue' with season_id=3, '2' matches neither, so the match fails
Pattern 2 then matches and strips '[PD' (opening bracket + PD) but leaves '2] Big Blue' — confirmed by running both patterns in Python: season_id=2 → 'Big Blue', season_id=3 → '2] Big Blue'
Only test case for remove_pd('[PD2] Big Blue') uses season_id=2 (the passing case); no test covers season_id != 2

triage.fix_sketch: In decksite/deck_name.py remove_pd(), add a new re.sub before the existing patterns that handles '[PDN]' bracket form for any digit N, e.g. re.sub(r'(^| )\[pd\d*\]( |$)', '\1\2', name, flags=re.IGNORECASE). Add a test to decksite/deck_name_test.py for remove_pd('[PD2] Big Blue', 3) == 'Big Blue'.
triage.notes: The existing test at line 340 only covers the same-season case; the bug only manifests when the deck's season_id differs from the number embedded in the [PDN] tag.
